agent_explanation: Emergency at t=861 for N preempts EW green immediately: at step 860 EW green, at 861 EW yellow with emergency active, at 862 NS green. The controller jumps from EW yellow directly to NS green with 0s all-red (need 4s) and truncates EW yellow to 1s (need 6s), violating all_red_clearance (and yellow_duration). Removing the emergency removes the failure.
